description: If \(\kappa\) is infinite, \(|X|\le\kappa\), \(|L|\le\kappa\) and \(\kappa\le|M|\), then the nonempty \(L\)-structure \(M\) has an elementary substructure containing \(X\) of cardinality exactly \(\kappa\).
signature:
FirstOrder.Language.exists_elementarySubstructure_card_eq.{u, v, w, w'} (L : FirstOrder.Language) {M : Type w}
  [L.Structure M] (s : Set M) (κ : Cardinal.{w'}) (h1 : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ κ)
  (h2 : Cardinal.lift.{w', w} (Cardinal.mk ↑s) ≤ Cardinal.lift.{w, w'} κ)
  (h3 : Cardinal.lift.{w', max u v} L.card ≤ Cardinal.lift.{max u v, w'} κ)
  (h4 : Cardinal.lift.{w, w'} κ ≤ Cardinal.lift.{w', w} (Cardinal.mk M)) :
  ∃ S, s ⊆ ↑S ∧ Cardinal.lift.{w', w} (Cardinal.mk ↥S) = Cardinal.lift.{w, w'} κ
